species.name: Mole
species.note: No visible eyes or external ears; the forelimbs sit at the very front, almost beside the head.

species.name: Shrew
mustRead: short velvety body and thin tail

species.name: Hedgehog
mustRead: dense cape of spines over the back
pointed pink snout poking out in front

species.name: Box Turtle
mustRead: hinged underside that shuts like a box

species.name: Fisher
mustRead: long low mustelid body with bushy tapering tail
broad rounded ears and blunt muzzle

species.name: River Otter
mustRead: thick muscular tail tapering to a point
blunt whiskered face with small ears

species.name: Beaver
mustRead: stocky humped body on short legs

species.name: Alligator Lizard
mustRead: very long tail far exceeding the body
stubby short legs on an elongate trunk
squared armoured scale rows with a fold along the flank

species.name: Giant Salamander
mustRead: wrinkled fleshy skin folds along the flanks

species.name: Wolverine
mustRead: heavy bear-like build with humped shoulders
pale stripe sweeping along each flank to the tail
bushy tail and huge clawed paws
species.note: It is a giant mustelid, not a small bear: body still long and low, legs short and stout.

species.name: Moose
mustRead: dewlap bell under the throat and humped shoulders
species.note: Legs are extremely long relative to the body; the animal is nearly as tall as it is long.

species.name: Reindeer
mustRead: antlers with a forward-sweeping brow shovel over the face
species.note: Both sexes carry antlers, unlike other deer.

species.name: Caribou
mustRead: tall sweeping antlers with a forward brow shovel
species.note: Same species as reindeer (wild North American form) - slightly leggier and leaner.

species.name: Red Fox
mustRead: sharp pointed ears and narrow muzzle

species.name: Arctic Fox
mustRead: thick fluffy all-white coat and dense round tail
species.note: Everything is shortened and rounded compared to a red fox - ears, muzzle and legs.

species.name: Snow Leopard
mustRead: pale smoky coat with large open rosettes
short stout legs and big paws
species.note: Tail is as long as the head and body; the muzzle is short and the skull domed, unlike other big cats.

species.name: Mountain Goat
mustRead: shaggy white coat with pantaloons on the legs
short slightly curved black dagger horns

species.name: Ibex
mustRead: massive backward-arcing horns with knobbed ridges

species.name: Chamois
mustRead: short vertical horns hooked sharply backward at the tips

species.name: Marmot
mustRead: fat barrel body on very short legs
blunt rounded head with small ears
species.note: Frequently drawn rearing upright on the haunches; the natural profile is low and squat.

species.name: Mountain Lizard
mustRead: tail longer than head and body combined
splayed sprawling legs with long clawed toes
species.note: Not a specific taxon - read as a generic alpine rock lizard (lacertid type).

species.name: Otter
mustRead: broad whiskered muzzle with tiny ears
